representative_headline: [WHISPERS] Hey, You Know, Republicans Should Just Fix Obamacare, Call It A Day
keywords: obamacare, health care, health, care, insurance, repeal, republican, gop, health insurance, medicaid
summary: The crash of Trumpcare opens the door to full Medicare For All. Among the casualties: Millions of Americans who wouldn't have health insurance. The reality is they may be even further away from an Obamacare replacement than before. The GOP Tax Cut Plan Opens A New Front In The War On Obamacare.
